content: Daniele and Adam - Shove Chapel, Colorado College I have known Paul for many years and he has been a personal friend and a blessing in my life.  When Adam and I got engaged Paul was the obvious choice to perform our ceremony and we were overjoyed when he agreed.  When personal tragedy struck our family only three months before our wedding, Paul was with us every step of the way.  He made it possible for us to manage our grief and understand that we could still accept the joy of our union.  Our wedding was everything we ever hoped it could be and even more.  Our day was perfect and the ceremony was beautiful and Adam and I know that Paul was an integral component of making that happen.  I will be eternally grateful to my friend that I will always have fond memories of our wedding day! Fall 2011
